definitions: To produce musical sounds with the voice.
To perform a song or vocal music.
To make a high-pitched, melodious sound (often used for birds or insects).
To confess or inform on others, especially under pressure (informal).
To make a humming or whistling sound, as from rapid motion or air passing through a narrow opening.
examples: She loves to sing in the shower.
He will sing a solo at the concert.
If you press him, he might sing about his accomplices.
